commitMessage:
fix: missing shared storage volume and loudness-off errors (#602)

* fix(download): fail at once when the shared storage volume is missing

On a device whose primary shared storage volume is missing or unmounted, every
MediaStore query on it throws. A download then logged an error looking for an
existing file, fetched the whole song four times, failed every save, and
reported again.

Check the volume first: the existing-file lookup returns nothing, and a download
whose save needs the volume fails at once with a warning, without fetching.
An audio download to a custom folder does not use the volume and still runs.

* fix(player): treat a failure to turn loudness off as a device limitation

Some audio effect engines throw when the loudness enhancer is turned off, as
they do when it is turned on. Turning it off now disables loudness for the
session like the other enhancer calls, instead of reporting the error.

No unit test: the failure is in the platform AudioEffect, which needs
framework infrastructure the project does not have.

* fix(download): check storage inside the error path, for the rendition actually saved
